findings.meaning: A legal p1/100.00/2026-10-16 request is permitted without any stored customer confirmation in both profiles. Tool descriptions instruct clear yes after read-back; the hard pre-hook does not require evidence of that yes. This is an enforcement gap, not evidence that a real customer dialogue lacked consent.
